notes.title: Version fix update announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022210/8ec29b663bea9deb472b10018da14097c71ba239.png[/img]

Dear players,

Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce to all players that "Who Do You Want to Fall in Love with, President" has ushered in the first version update. This update mainly includes the following contents, please check it out:

[list]
[*] [b][Fix] Fix the stuttering problem reported by players, and add a picture quality option in the game. If you have encountered stuttering problems before, please switch the picture quality to: HD mode;[/b]
[*] [b][Fix] Fix the problem that some achievements are not synchronized to Steam. If the achievements are not unlocked on Steam or Epic platform at that time, you will automatically synchronize the unlocking status of the achievements after exiting and re-entering;[/b]
[*] [b][Optimization] Optimize the difficulty of unlocking achievements and photos. This update also makes some prompt updates for the unlocking of achievements and photos. For unlocked achievements or photos, some corresponding prompt information will be given after clicking;[/b]
[*] [b][Optimization] Optimize the problem of non-4K high-definition pictures when downloading photos;[/b]
[*] [b][Optimization] Add the option of English subtitles, players can switch the display of Chinese and English subtitles;[/b]
[/list]

The above is all the content updated in this version. Welcome all players to experience it. We are very happy for you to join our Q group 772576410. We look forward to communicating with you at any time. Your support is our greatest motivation. Thank you very much!

———"CEO" technical team presents

notes.title: Three free DLC update instructions
notes.content:
Dear players:

Hi!
Thank you for your support and companionship for our game. In order to thank all players, we plan to update three free DLCs in the future. All players who own and purchase this game can get DLC for free.
The DLC update plan is as follows:

[olist]
[*] [b]Music update DLC-Original soundtrack collection: Contains a total of six themes and 14 original soundtracks;[/b]
[*] [b]Photo update DLC-Fine stills collection: It is estimated that it contains more than 100 fine high-definition stills, original pictures with resolutions above 4K;[/b]
[*] [b]Video update DLC-Video highlights collection: It is expected to contain a large number of behind-the-scenes content such as actor makeup test and shooting.[/b]
[/olist]

According to the difficulty of material sorting and collection, we will first update the music collection DLC, and then update the picture and video DLC in turn.
Thank you for your support and company, and I hope to be with you in the future.

——————"CEO" production team
